import sys, socket,re
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(1000000)
from chall import check
for b in [2000,2001,15000]:
 d=[b-4,2,1]+[0]*(b-4)
 d[b-4]=1
 n=sum(x*pow(b,b-1-i) for i,x in enumerate(d))
 print('local',b,check(b,n))
s=socket.create_connection(('172.19.0.1',21200),timeout=5)
f=s.makefile('rwb', buffering=0)
prompt=f.readline(); print(prompt.decode(),end='')
b=int(re.search(rb'base (\d+)',prompt).group(1))
d=[b-4,2,1]+[0]*(b-4); d[b-4]=1
n=sum(x*pow(b,b-1-i) for i,x in enumerate(d))
f.write(str(n).encode()+b'\n')
print(f.read().decode(errors='replace'))
PY", "timeout_seconds": 25}
